name: Audit actual existing entitlements
target: Original tiers kept separate; actual rights unverified
increment: Maintain account-specific current rights; relative zero not absolute cost zero
mechanism: Preserve current experience and value boundary; reference only
benefit: Baseline effective practice and complete billing contribution; not demonstrated optimal
cost: Actual existing serving costs; no fabricated zero-cost baseline
risk: Delayed learning opportunity; current qualification not known
kpi: Account qualification and baseline whole-period measures
evidence: S001|S019|S020; provider facts do not establish current target rights
decision: Audit P0 before defining any treatment
stop_rule: Do not replace actual rights with Max-only assumption

name: Candidate incremental Super access
target: Original Super with verified unmet entitlement; H1 task and actual speaking level
increment: Only a verified new entitlement or quota; dose and window unset
mechanism: Potentially reduce natural speaking friction; learning and billing hypotheses separate
benefit: Useful expression and possible retention/renewal contribution; unmeasured
cost: Both-arm offer and paid-follow-on serving cost plus actual incremental fixed expense
risk: No actual increment; learning displacement; foregone Max purchase; original-Max spillover
kpi: Stage5 to select one primary; learning/displacement/billing/cost guardrails required
evidence: Restricted S011/S015 learning signal; S001 company direction; no P1 economic calibration
decision: Unconfirmed branch; verify increment and authority before choosing a trial
entry_gate: Real eligible subgroup exists; implementation route and matched evidence contract
stop_rule: Confirmed no increment => stop this definition; no authorization => design or independent task study only

name: Candidate limited Free trial
target: Original Free without an equivalent existing Lily trial
increment: A verified trial increment; quota/expiry/window not fixed without evidence
mechanism: Potentially lower access friction; first-paid contribution remains a hypothesis
benefit: Useful practice and first-paid contribution; not a conversion forecast
cost: Trial failures and retries plus changed paid-follow-on costs and incremental fixed expense
risk: Equivalent existing trial; ineffective dose; paid diversion; unmeasured Max spillover
kpi: Stage5 to choose primary; complete assigned-account billing and learning/cost guards
evidence: S001 general longer-trial statement is not Lily-specific uplift; no economic calibration
decision: Retain candidate; no current Scale or profitability choice
entry_gate: Verify actual trial rights and feasible implementation; align learning/cost/billing periods
stop_rule: No genuine increment => stop definition; unknown contribution/cost/spillover => no whole-policy winner
